topic: What if there were no friction? You could not walk, hold a cup or tie your shoes; everything would slide forever.

episode.title: What If There Were No Friction?

shots.narration: What if there were no friction?
shots.scene: Colourful 3D science lab, vertical frame, glowing tabletop hologram of a smooth floor, no text or symbols.
shots.action: Nova unveils the floor hologram before Byte.
shots.mood: Bright cyan light, curious expressions, playful anticipation.

shots.narration: Your feet couldn't grip the ground to walk.
shots.scene: Colourful lab beside a large hologram of empty boots on a level floor, no text.
shots.action: The holographic boots slip backward during an attempted step.
shots.mood: Playful surprise, clean blue lighting, clearly visible slippery soles.

shots.narration: [surprised] A cup would slip through your fingers.
shots.scene: Close view of Nova's hands inside a glowing cup simulation, padded tray underneath, no text.
shots.action: The holographic cup slides through Nova's loosely gripping fingers.
shots.mood: Gentle comedy, bright turquoise glow, Byte's wide blue eyes.

shots.narration: Even shoelace knots couldn't grip themselves to stay tied.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with an enlarged holographic shoe and loosely knotted laces, no text.
shots.action: A holographic lace slides out of its knot under tension.
shots.mood: Curious and clear, contrasting orange laces against blue holographic light.

shots.narration: Sliding objects keep moving unless another force changes their motion.
shots.scene: Tall lab hologram containing a level track and a single smooth block, no text.
shots.action: The block glides steadily along the track.
shots.mood: Mesmerising smooth motion, bright colours, attentive expressions.

shots.narration: [excited] But gravity would still pull things downhill!
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a glowing holographic ramp and smooth block, no text.
shots.action: The block accelerates down the ramp.
shots.mood: Energetic discovery, warm yellow highlights, delighted faces.

shots.narration: Without friction, ordinary brakes couldn't stop spinning wheels.
shots.scene: Lab hologram showing an isolated wheel between smooth brake pads, no vehicle or text.
shots.action: The holographic wheel keeps spinning between the closed brake pads.
shots.mood: Intriguing mechanical close-up, bright blue and orange lighting.

shots.narration: Friction gives us the grip we usually take for granted.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a restored-friction hologram of boots planted on a textured floor, no text.
shots.action: A holographic boot takes a firm step forward.
shots.mood: Satisfying resolution, warm lighting, cheerful smiles.

shots.narration: [excited] Friction warms your hands—what if gravity disappeared?
shots.scene: Bright lab with a glowing planet hologram behind Nova, subtle orange warmth around her palms, no text.
shots.mood: Warm discovery, sparkling curiosity, inviting cosmic backdrop.

episode.description: Dr. Nova shows Byte a world without friction, where walking, holding cups, and tying shoes become surprisingly difficult. Discover why this everyday force gives us grip—and even warmth.
